and their fruitfulness, so that they may be saved
from all harmful occurrences, and
be abundant. By this sign of the Holy
Cross, and by this Holy Gospel, and by the grace of this
day, in the name of the Father, and of the Son,
and of the Holy Spirit, now and always, and
unto the ages of ages. Amen. Alleluia.
And having placed the Holy Cross in the tray, they
shall go toward the south, saying, "Holy
God" according to what is written above. After which:
Hymn, Tone 2nd Plagal [bki], "The Life-Giving Cross" (Khachn kenarar). And at the end,
"Stand up" [Orthi]. Gospel: John 14:1
"Let not [your heart] be troubled," to verse 13, "the Father in the Son."
The Deacon shall proclaim: "For the
monasteries, hermitages, and all churches
of ours, let us pray to the Lord." And the
bishop shall say forty times, "Lord,
have mercy." And the deacon shall say: "Bless,
Lord." And the bishop, taking the Holy
Cross and raising it, shall sign with the Cross,
saying:
"May the northern side of this
world, the monasteries, hermitages, and all
Armenian churches, along with the clergy and people, be blessed,
and protected, and kept under providence; so that they may remain
in construction, in good order, and
in peace. By this sign of the Holy
Cross, and by this Holy Gospel, and
by the grace of this day, in the name of the Father, and of
the Son, and of the Holy Spirit, now and
always, and unto the ages of ages. Amen.
Blessing and glory to the Father, and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit, now and always, and
unto the ages of ages. Amen." And they
shall go to the chancel of the church, and shall place
the Holy Cross and the Gospel upon the
altar in the chancel, and all shall bow down,
and they shall begin the Hymn, Tone 2nd Plagal [bki],
"Of Your Cross, O Christ." And at the completion of the
hymn: Proclamation: "By this Holy Cross."
Prayer: "Protect [us]". "Our Father who art in heaven."
And then they shall perform the common service.
"I cried unto God." Messedi:
"You have given to those who fear." "As they were saved."
Proclamation: "Let us say." Hymn at Peace/Lifting up [Hambartsi], Tone 4th [gi], "Power of the Holy Cross." Proclamation: "By this Holy Cross," "Save [us]". Prayer: "Protect [us]." And let there be
no more procession until the Presentation of the Lord [Tyarnndaraj], and
from there until Palm Sunday [Tsaghkazard].

Monday. Feast of the Cross. Tone 4th [dza].
"Power of the Holy Cross," with its canons [sarokn].
Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "Mother of Light." Morning Song:
"You have given to those who fear." Proclamation: "Let us say."
Hymns of the Infants [Mankunk]: Of the Cross, from the Tone of the day. After which: "By this Holy
Cross," "Save [us]". Prayer: "Protect [us]."
At the Liturgy, Introit: "Before the precious."
Midday Psalm [Pokh]: "The Lord reigns." Hymn, Tone 4th [dza],
"From the Heavens." Psalm 59 [60]: "You have given to those who fear",
response, "O God, You have rejected us."
Prophet Isaiah 65:22: "Thus says the Lord,"
to verse 25: "[my holy mountain,] says the Lord." Epistle: 1
Corinthians 2:6: "We speak wisdom,"
to verse 10: "even the deep things of God." Alleluia: "You have given to those who fear." Gospel: John 3:22:
"After this [Jesus] came," to verse 36: "abides upon him."
In the Evening, Messedi: "You have given...", "As they were saved." Hymn at Peace/Lifting up [Hambartsi], Tone 2nd Plagal [bki]: "The Life-Giving Cross." Proclamation: "By this Holy Cross," "Save [us]". Prayer: "Protect [us]."

Tuesday. Feast of the Church. Tone
2nd Plagal [bki]: "The Life-Giving Cross," and "You who sit on the throne of glory," which is of the Resurrection; find it and sing it, Tone 3rd [gi]: "Holy of Holies." For the Canticle of the Shoghakat, say it in Tone 4th [gd], "Rejoice this day," with its canons.
Magnificat [Metsatsustse]: "Rejoice, O Mother of God." Morning
Song: "Holiness is fitting for Your house." Proclamation:
"Let us say." Hymns of the Infants [Mankunk]: Of the Cross, from the Tone. After which:
"By this Holy Church," "Save [us]". Prayer: "At the door of this holy temple."
At the Liturgy, Introit: "The Peace." Response [Pokh]: "The Lord reigns." Hymn, Tone 4th [dza]: "Who established." Psalm 117 [118]: "This is the day that the Lord has made." Prophet Jeremiah / Baruch 4:36: "Look toward the east," to 5:9: "with righteousness from Him." Epistle: Hebrews 3:1: "Therefore, brothers," to verse 6: "if we hold fast." Alleluia: "The Lord loved Zion and chose it to dwell." Gospel: John 2:12: "After this he went down," to verse 22: "Jesus had said." hagiography [Srbasatsutyun]: "Angelic." In the Evening, Messedi: "Here bless," "O you who stand." Hymn at Peace/Lifting up [Hambartsi], Tone 3rd [gi]: "Rejoice, O Holy Church." Proclamation: "By this Holy Church," "Save [us]". Prayer: "In the midst of this temple."
